text: Hi, I'm Eka! Ever wondered what it takes to build a knowledge hub with an AI agent? Let's find out!
Step one: Understand! Know your users, their questions, and trusted sources.
Two: Content! Accurate, up-to-date content means great answers!
Three: Metadata! Tags, owners and review dates show what can be trusted!
Four: Format! Clear headings and simple language make it easy to understand!
Five: Governance! Owners and access rules keep knowledge safe and reliable!
Six: Automation! Workflows handle reviews and updates, so content stays fresh!
Seven: the AI agent! That's me! Linked to trusted content, with a clear purpose!
Eight: Analytics! Track usage and feedback, so the hub keeps getting better!
Trusted content! Clear governance! Continuous improvement!
Get these right, and your AI agent delivers accurate knowledge, helping everyone work smarter! Woohoo!
